_metadata.description: WellaPath Nigeria CDSS - Symptom Vocabulary 2.0 CANDIDATE. Lossless migration of token_dictionary 1.1 to schema 2.0. Not published, not clinically approved, not referenced by any live manifest.

legacy_metadata.description: WellaPath Nigeria CDSS — Symptom Token Dictionary. Machine-readable vocabulary for all 50 pilot conditions. All tokens are lowercase_snake_case. No duplicates across categories.
rules: All tokens lowercase_snake_case — no spaces, no hyphens, no capitals
No duplicate tokens across the entire dictionary
Common symptoms shared across conditions use the SAME token
Tokens must be atomic — one concept per token
Once locked, tokens cannot be renamed without a schema version bump
corrections_from_v0: Added 6 missing symptom_tokens found in KB symptom_weights: abdominal_cramps, backache, difficulty_breathing, excessive_thirst, frequent_urination, wheeze
Removed 'wheezing' — consolidated into 'wheeze' as canonical token (wheeze used in chronic_respiratory; wheezing was duplicate synonym)
Removed duplicate 'haemoptysis' from symptom_tokens — haemoptysis is a red flag (blood in sputum = danger sign); kept only in red_flag_tokens
Removed duplicate 'petechial_rash' from red_flag_tokens — petechial_rash as observed symptom stays in symptom_tokens; severe petechial rash with fever = red flag handled via condition logic
Added 'petechial_rash_fever' as dedicated red_flag_token to distinguish the danger sign from the symptom observation
Removed 'exertional_shortness_of_breath' — consolidated into 'exertional_breathlessness' (synonym, exertional_breathlessness already present)
Kept 'hearing_loss' — valid symptom for ear_infections and chronic conditions even if not currently in symptom_weights JSON

v1.1: Split severe_malnutrition_sam_mam into two tokens — severe_malnutrition_sam (escalate_emergency) and moderate_malnutrition_mam (increase_urgency). Clinical rationale: MAM and SAM have different urgency thresholds.

changelog: Schema 2.0: added per-token entries under `tokens`, separating clinical identity from search and display metadata.
Schema 2.0: added `body_areas` and `complaint_groups` controlled vocabularies. body_areas is derived from the existing body_area_tokens; complaint_groups is empty pending an approved catalogue.
Schema 2.0: added `search_index.normalized_forms`, generated from `tokens` so every consumer resolves identically offline.
Migration: all 295 token IDs from 1.1 preserved, in category and in order. No token renamed, merged, removed or deprecated.
Migration: the six schema 1.0 token arrays are carried forward unchanged so schema 1.0 consumers keep working without a code change.
Migration: no alias, body-area association, complaint group, severity descriptor, duration descriptor or reviewer value was invented. All are empty or null.
Migration: `display.canonical_label` is mechanically derived from the token ID and marked unreviewed and not display-safe.
Not published. release_status is candidate_unapproved and the live /config manifest is unchanged.
provenance: Source: token_dictionary.ng.v1.1.json (sha256:0cc47ad9537c0bd4c6ef3aec8f1931eb9b4c62103a8809d16544f94a90b5c019), the artifact frozen for internal beta at E9.1.
introduced_in_artifact_version derived by diffing token_dictionary.ng.v1.0.json against token_dictionary.ng.v1.1.json.
No external vocabulary, alias list or clinical catalogue was consulted or imported.
No PHI and no real-user assessment data is present: this artifact contains only token identifiers already published in token_dictionary.ng.v1.1.json.
